Caldera de Taburiente National Park | Caldera de Taburiente National Park (Spanish: "Parque Nacional de la Caldera de Taburiente" ) is large geological feature on the island of La Palma, Canary Islands, Spain. Roque de los Muchachos | Roque de los Muchachos (English: "Rock of the Boys") is a rocky mound at the highest point on the island of La Palma in the Canary Islands, Spain.
